summary: Update the backend runtime to Node.js 24.22.3 to fix CVE-2026-123863, a denial of service caused by improper HTTP/2 session teardown.
userImpact: No behavior change. The backend keeps the Node.js 24 major and its existing configuration.

instructions: Deploy the new backend image. No configuration or data changes are needed.

configuration: No new runtime configuration is required.

notes: Migration inventories and schema-plan identities remain unchanged.

security: Pin the Wolfi backend runtime to nodejs-24 24.22.3-r2, which contains the fix for CVE-2026-123863 (HIGH).
documentation: docs/runbooks/security-dependency-updates.md records the new backend Node.js pin.
rollback: Restore the previous image only after independently checking its current security acceptance.
validation: Dependency-security override tests, the backend production image build and an exact-image vulnerability scan.
